items.reasoning: Evaluated under Mode B (mechanistic and qualitative analysis), the report and Figure 4 accurately capture the core T4c ensemble clustering findings: using UMAP and GMM clustering on natural-movie responses across the 50 DMNs, T4c separates into three discrete clusters—correct upward selectivity (C0, n=31, loss 5.30), inverted downward selectivity (C1, n=7, loss 5.32), and no direction selectivity (C2, n=12, loss 5.36)—with mean task loss increasing sequentially. Furthermore, the agent rigorously links T4c tuning sign to Mi4/Mi9 contrast polarity via flash-response scatter plots, a contingency table (chi-square p=0.0002, Fisher p=3.2e-6), and a causal Mi4/Mi9 silencing double dissociation, even extending the UMAP analysis to T5c. However, it relies on precomputed UMAP/GMM files without showing BIC selection or a broad multi-cell-type clustering overview, lacks per-cluster error distribution plots beyond mean losses, and only briefly alludes to rather than demonstrating the strategy of constraining whole-circuit predictions by measuring a few neurons, placing it just shy of the full scope of the original paper.
